newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria's oil ministry, NNPC move to Abuja.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria's oil ministry, NNPC move to Abuja.

text.p: State-run Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC) and the oil ministry have moved their offices to the capital Abuja from Lagos, an official statement said on Thursday.
It said any transactions with the NNPC and the ministry would now be done in Abuja.
The move was in compliance with a directive from the military government that all federal ministries and government agencies should relocate to Abuja by end-October.
The statement said only the offices of its managing director and its six executive directors had moved to Abuja for now. It did not say when the others would be relocated.
